generate_different_tempos: Switches scans between Quick and Long mode. When enabled, WerZatSonGUI generates tempo/pitch-shifted variations of each file before scanning them, to help identify songs that have been sped up, slowed down, or pitch-shifted. This is much slower, since it effectively scans multiple variations of each file instead of just the original.
negative_tempo_array: The tempo ratios (below 1.0) used to generate slowed-down/pitch-shifted-down variations of each file in Long mode. Edit this as a comma-separated list in brackets, e.g. [0.9, 0.95]. Leaving this empty uses only the positive array; leaving both empty restores the full default set of variations.
positive_tempo_array: The tempo ratios (above 1.0) used to generate sped-up/pitch-shifted-up variations of each file in Long mode. Edit this as a comma-separated list in brackets, e.g. [1.05, 1.1]. Leaving this empty uses only the negative array; leaving both empty restores the full default set of variations.
fingerprint_subfolder: Restricts Audfprint mode to a single subfolder of your Audfprint Database Directory instead of searching all of them. Use Browse... to select one, or type its name directly. The folder you select must already exist inside the Audfprint Database Directory.
custom_webhook_name: Overrides the display name your Discord webhook uses when posting, replacing the default "WerZatSong".
custom_webhook_image: Overrides the avatar image your Discord webhook uses when posting. The link must start with either https://cdn.discordapp.com/icons/ or https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/, or Discord won't recognize it. You can get a correctly formatted link by setting the image as a Discord bot's profile picture and copying the link from there.
thread_count: Sets how many CPU threads Audfprint mode uses. Capped at 16 regardless of what you enter, to help prevent running out of memory. Leaving this unchecked allows Audfprint to use all available threads on your machine automatically.
musicbrainz_duration_range: Restricts MusicBrainz matches to songs whose duration (in seconds) falls between the two values you enter. Each value must be between 30 and 600; anything outside that range is reset to the default (30/600).
musicbrainz_extension: Helps MusicBrainz find a match when the beginning of your audio file is cut off or delayed by the number of seconds you enter. Must be between 1 and 25; anything outside that range is reset to the default (25).
search_depth: Controls how aggressively the program searches for a match (1-8). Higher values perform a more thorough "deep search" for low-quality clips, but may significantly increase processing time. The default is 4.
mark_all_audio_files_as_processed: Useful when you have a lot of files in your input folder but only want to run a few of them. Marks all audio files as processed in Quick mode (no tempo variations), Long mode (original files and tempo variations), or both. You can then edit PROCESSED.txt and remove the songs you *want* to run. Note: pressing any of the three buttons will overwrite your current PROCESSED.txt file.
theme_mode: Changes the visual appearance of the application. Set to Light, Dark, or System Default to automatically match your OS settings.
language: Selects the language used for the interface. Changes take effect immediately.
